notes: S1 done (PR #591). S2 done (PR #592). S3a done (PR #593, direct sites 9->7). S3b done (PR #594, 7->6). S3c-1 done (PR #595, 6->5, ripple.get_report + ToolResult.error_kind). S3c-2 (this branch): adds the domain-outcome channel (ErrorKind.DOMAIN + DomainOutcome + ToolResult.domain, returned immediately and never retried) and migrates ripple.predict_spread / ripple.validate_pmf, so direct sites go 5->3. The Gateway net for those two is declared ABOVE their own payload max_wait (3600s vs 1800s default), because a Gateway timeout would cancel the call and lose the job_id that makes cancel/resume possible. integration no longer swallows exceptions, and the service's degraded answer (ripple_fallback=True + zeroed body) is now DomainOutcome(unavailable) instead of being read as a real prediction. Remaining direct sites: trend_scout xhs x3 (S3d).
